entries.claim: This dependent same-recension digital comparison supplies the explicitly resolved Latin reading; it does not establish independent transmission or another printed edition.

The approved Benziger page prints the complete selected Matthew 28:1–7 reading. The transcription excludes typographic speech marks used around the angel’s words, without omitting their sacred text; the printed facti controls the separately recorded digital factu corrigendum.
